The plow has multiple large, circular metal discs that are turning over thick slices of reddish-brown soil. In the background, there is a rural landscape with hills, trees, and farm buildings under a hazy sky.

While the frame is substantial, it does not clearly 'significantly exceed human height' in its vertical dimension; it is roughly waist-to-chest high on the operator. The description fits a moldboard plow better than the disc plow shown.
